src.gen: A casino floor at night, one green felt blackjack table, a man in a dark suit seen from behind sitting alone opposite a dealer in a white shirt and black vest, a single deck of cards on the felt, warm lamps, slot machines glowing far behind
src.move: the dealer deals cards one at a time onto the felt, the slot machine lights blink in the background

src.gen: Close view of a green felt blackjack table in a casino, tall stacks of casino chips in many colours piled in front of a player's hands in dark suit sleeves, playing cards beside them, warm low light
src.move: the dealer's hand pushes one more tall stack of chips across the felt toward the player

src.gen: A casino blackjack table seen from behind the player: a seated man in a dark suit, and two very large security men in black suits standing close on his left and on his right, casino lights behind them
src.move: one of the large men lifts his hand and taps the seated man on the shoulder, the seated man turns his head

src.gen: A dim old-style casino restaurant with red leather booths, at the table in the far back a big heavy-set Italian man in a dark suit sitting alone eating a plate of spaghetti, white tablecloth, warm lamp light
src.move: the big man twirls spaghetti on his fork and slowly looks up
